status: finite diagnostic follow-up to the coarse cross-geometry core-overlap triggers
physical_overlap: C_left.T @ S_cross_geometry @ C_right, with exact spherical cross-geometry AO overlap integrals in the saved common molecular frame
ao_transport_overlap: (S_left**(1/2) @ C_left).T @ (S_right**(1/2) @ C_right), using symmetric positive-definite metric square roots and identical ordered atom/basis/AO labels
interpretation: The AO-indexed Lowdin transport identifies orthonormal coefficient frames while the atom-centred basis moves. Comparing it with physical overlap diagnoses basis-centre motion sensitivity; neither can establish many-electron state identity or a resonance-pole assignment.
controls: Positive-definite AO metrics, metric-square-root reconstruction, orthonormal transported orbitals, same-geometry identity, reverse-pair reciprocity, finite singular values bounded by one, column-sign and orthogonal within-subspace rotation invariance
release: One fresh saved-checkpoint screen, immutable source/input hashes and measured resources. Preserve the original core-overlap triggers and keep the final state-identity verdict unset.
